name: hand-dubstep-140-v4
title: hand-dubstep 140, v4
description: A whole dubstep track in one program: intro, build with a riser, drop on a wobble bass under a once-a-bar filter, breakdown, second build and drop, half-time, slam and outro. The v2, v3, v4 line; uses defs, accents, slides, seeded humanize and every().

name: matrix-130
title: matrix 130
description: A D-phrygian driving track in eight sections (intro, breakin, drive, breakdown, riser, climax, lift, outro) with generated arps, seeded degrade and an evolve in the climax that settles into a cycle.

name: trance-138
title: trance 138
description: A 64-bar trance track (intro 16, breakdown 16, drop 24, outro 8) said once with lets, two defs, four sections and an arrange. The same song written longhand has the same net CIDs.

name: hand-dubstep-140-v2
title: hand-dubstep 140, v2
description: The first whole-track dubstep program: six sections, a riser that opens over eight bars and lands on the drop, a wobble-lead bass under a filter that opens and shuts once a bar. The smallest complete song here.

name: markers-demo
title: markers demo
description: A 24-bar program that lights up every kind of marker in the editor: a def, a repeat of filter ramps, an evolve with a stop, and a timed control line. Short, with sections and an arrange.

name: first-beat
title: first beat
description: A four-line beat: tempo, drums on deck A, bass and a pad on deck B, and an end. Start here to see what a deck line is.

name: acid-line
title: acid line
description: A squelchy FM bass line with an accent (!) and a slide (^), a kick and hats, and a filter cutoff and resonance that ramp over 16 bars. Shows let, accents, slides and ramps.

name: evolve-demo
title: evolve demo
description: A program that changes itself: every 4 bars the melody rotates and climbs and the hi-hat thins out, until generation 7. Shows evolve, rotate, transpose with per-generation values, thin and a stop bound.
